_comment: Settings of the lv-screening toolchain. Paths are relative to this file's folder.
_demand_factor_comment: Planning demand of every connection as a fraction of its fuse-rated peak (DSO value, 6 %). Used by the one-shot snapshot and as the magnitude of the synthetic demand profiles.

oneshot._comment: Snapshot of the data sanity check: demand_factor x fuse-rated peak at every connection at the same instant, plus generation_factor x existing PV.

demand._comment: Synthetic household day profiles (GMM on HEAPO smart-meter data, Grammatikos/Ali/Sossan 2026), scaled per node to demand_factor x fuse-rated peak.

pv._comment: Yearly normalised PV profile (per unit of kWp). One representative day is picked: the real day closest to the season's mean shape.

ev._comment: Uncontrolled residential charging: each EV charges at charger_kw for duration_h after a truncated-normal arrival time. 11 kW x 4 h is the DSO's upper-bound assumption.

scenarios._comment: SFOE Energy Perspectives 2050+ (PE2050+), Scenario-cadre 2030/2040. National PV and EV are scaled to Sion+Sierre by population and allocated to networks and nodes in proportion to fuse-rated peak demand.
